description: This file defines the SparkThrowable interface used for error handling in Apache Spark, including methods for error condition, error class, SQL state, internal error check, breaking change info, message parameters, and message templates.

classes.name: SparkThrowable
classes.description: Interface for throwable errors in Spark, providing methods for error condition, categorization, SQL state, internal error status, breaking change info, message parameters, and message templates.

methods.name: getCondition
methods.description: Returns a succinct, human-readable, unique, and consistent representation of the error condition.

methods.name: getErrorClass
methods.description: Deprecated. Previously used to get the error class; now defaults to getCondition().

methods.name: getSqlState
methods.description: Deprecated. Provides a custom SQL state; defaults to SparkThrowableHelper.getSqlState.

methods.name: isInternalError
methods.description: Checks if the error is an internal error.

methods.name: getBreakingChangeInfo
methods.description: Returns information about breaking changes related to the error condition.

methods.name: getMessageParameters
methods.description: Provides message parameters for error message formatting.

methods.name: getDefaultMessageTemplate
methods.description: Returns the default message template for the error, or null if unavailable.

methods.name: getQueryContext
methods.description: Returns an array of QueryContext objects related to the error.
